All done. Here's a summary:

## Rollback: checkout-api

**Problem:** The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.

**Action:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. (Since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required under the org policy.)

**Result:** Verified post-rollback — checkout-api is now **healthy in all regions** on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to **0.2%**.

## Incident
Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident record documents the failure, the rollback, the verified recovery, and a follow-up item to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before the next deploy. (The first attempt to create the incident timed out; I retried with an idempotency key, so no duplicate incident exists.)
